reviewed_by: Delegated Task B coding agent: source-semantic review against the live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP view of retail igi.exe (entry 0x004A50F5) and the bound Radare2 artifacts; candidate translation unit recompiled with the repository -O3 flags.
review_basis: The current engine/src/retail/model/iff_chunk_tree.cpp hashes to 69b2e71f88a595c3cfcccf5b40df8c3ca54412b41ff46f09a0585175dc050ace. The retail entry was re-read through the live Binary Ninja view (decompile and block/edge sets) for this review, and the bound Radare2 artifact is unchanged. The candidate object and its linked-image symbol were then compared to that reconstruction. This review supersedes the earlier report that did not use the seven required semantic check names or that described the retail child link offset incorrectly.

candidate_function.summary: IffChunk_FindBelowForm: skips the given node when its form_type already equals the query, then performs the same walk and child recursion as IffChunk_FindByTag.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.detail: Retail 0x005178E0 (Binary Ninja Terrain_RenderQuadtree_6) is the find-below-a-form walk: it first skips the given node when that node's form type already equals the query, then walks the sibling chain exactly like 0x00517890. The candidate IffChunk_FindBelowForm performs the same pre-skip and walk.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.detail: Retail signature void**(void** arg1, int32_t arg2): arg1 is the starting node, arg2 the 32-bit tag. Candidate IffChunk_FindBelowForm(IffChunkNode*, std::uint32_t) keeps the same two-argument cdecl layout.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.detail: Same FORM marker 0x464F524D and offsets +0x00/+0x08/+0x10/+0x14 as 0x00517890; no scaling.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.detail: Same representation difference as 0x00517890: raw retail links become typed IffChunkNode pointers; selection identity is preserved.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.detail: Retail recurses into 0x00517890 for a matching form's first child and makes no other calls. The candidate recurses into IffChunk_FindByTag, preserving the call shape. In the linked image this function itself has zero call sites, so it is addressable but not statically reachable.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.detail: Retail returns the selected node pointer or null, including the initial skip path. The candidate returns the same selected node or nullptr.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: No floating-point value, constant or comparison appears in the retail function or the candidate.

checks.name: addressability
checks.detail: Present with external linkage (nm type T) at 0x004238A0 in build-clean-win32/igi1.exe; zero call sites, so addressable but not reachable.

checks.name: port_only_divergence
checks.detail: Port-only divergence: C++ linkage and typed IffChunkNode pointers, plus no caller at all in the port. The missing caller is a reachability gap, not an addressability gap; wiring a caller would change behaviour and is out of scope.

signature_comparison.rationale: Retail is void**(void**, int32_t); the candidate is IffChunkNode*(IffChunkNode*, std::uint32_t). The two-argument cdecl layout and pointer return are preserved.

limitations: The port holds the tree by value/unique_ptr; raw retail link addresses are not reproduced.
This function has no caller in the port, so it can never be observed at runtime as written.
No live paired retail/candidate game-process capture exists; STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED is the maximum supported status.
The CFG agreement cited is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image, not a candidate-vs-retail isomorphism score.

port_only_divergences.detail: retail symbol name Iff_FindChunkBelowForm -> candidate mangled IffChunk_FindBelowForm; codegen unchanged.
the candidate function has no caller; retail's consumers are not yet wired.
